Production is anchored at a single integrated manufacturing platform at Toopran near Hyderabad, supported by regional offices at Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Guwahati and Lucknow, and leaf operations at Guntur. risks.note: The Company operates under an increasingly stringent regulatory regime (COTPA guidelines on packaging and labelling, advertising and promotion), complicated by differing regimes across states and lack of consensus on interpretation. Restrictive rules subject to interpretation could result in penalties or loss of reputation, and could impair the ability to communicate with adult smokers or to meet consumer expectations through new brand launches or geographic expansion. Mitigation is continuous social dialogue with stakeholders and the regulatory community through industry bodies, plus building capability to launch compliant, consumer-acceptable brands.
risks.risk: Regulatory restrictions on tobacco could impair long-term revenue growth

risks.note: Manufacturing and marketing of cigarettes accounts for 100% of the business activity reported in the BRSR, with cigarettes containing tobacco at 84.8% of turnover and unmanufactured tobacco at 15.2%. There are no subsidiaries or joint ventures to diversify the earnings base, so any category-level shock (tax, regulation, consumption) transmits directly.

BRSR material issue: tobacco cultivation is water-intensive, exposing the business and its supply chain to water scarcity risk; any disruption in water availability directly affects raw material supply. Mitigated through water management and harvesting initiatives across sourcing geographies, Zero Liquid Discharge operation at the Toopran unit, periodic monitoring of withdrawal/consumption/discharge, a formal Water Stewardship Policy, a water risk assessment, and AWS Gold certification for Toopran.
risks.risk: Water scarcity across the sourcing base

risks.note: BRSR material issue flagged with negative financial implications: GHG emissions are central to the Company's climate response and tightening carbon policy frameworks across operating regions create growing regulatory exposure. Mitigation is annual measurement and tracking, progressively increasing renewable energy use, transitioning to cleaner fuels, and working with the agricultural supply chain to reduce Scope 3 emissions.

BRSR material issue with negative financial implications: energy management reduces operating cost and mitigates supply-scarcity risk, and supports compliance with evolving statutory requirements. Mitigation is facility-level consumption tracking and a structured energy management strategy that progressively increases the renewable share of the energy mix.

BRSR material issue: farmers face significant challenges around sustainable agricultural practices that can affect the quality and availability of the Company's raw material; a stable sourcing base depends on farmers thriving. The Company is strengthening farm productivity initiatives focused on soil quality, seed quality and mechanisation of field operations.

Higher crop production across Brazil, Zimbabwe, Malawi and India increased global leaf availability and pushed international prices down; importers optimised inventory and staggered buying, slowing procurement and extending shipment timelines, so the Indian industry faced subdued demand amid intensified competition among exporting countries. Order and shipment movement was slow during the year.
risks.risk: Leaf tobacco export demand and price realisation cycle

risks.note: Permanent employee turnover was 23% in FY 2025-26 (30% for females) after 34% in FY 2024-25, against a total headcount of 712 people as at 31st March 2026 comprising 359 management staff and 353 workmen - a structural retention exposure for an organisation this size, only partly addressed through campus hiring, Development Centres, leadership IDPs and internal promotion.
risks.risk: Employee attrition in a small workforce
